title: Title & Registration Services Extension Tags: Carry-Over of the Current Tag's Unused Days
content:
On a Title & Registration Services order, the unused days of the current tag carry over to the extension at a carry-over share: the share is one (1) when the extension is issued before the current tag's expiration date recorded on the order and the order is not awaiting the customer's documents, one half (0.5) when it is issued before that date while the order is awaiting the customer's documents, and zero otherwise. The carried-over days are the calendar days from the issue date to that expiration date multiplied by the carry-over share and rounded down to a whole day; they are added to the extension tag's validity.

"Awaiting the customer's documents" means the title order's status is awaiting documents. The expiration date used is the one recorded on the order for the tag currently on the vehicle.

| Issued before the current tag's expiration date | Order status awaiting documents | Carry-over share |
|---|---|---|
| yes | no | one |
| yes | yes | one half |
| no (on the expiration date or later) | either | zero |

## Worked examples (hypothetical, current tag expiring 20 May)

| Issue date | Order status | Unused days | Share | Carried-over days |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 13 May | submitted | 7 | one | 7 |
| 13 May | awaiting documents | 7 | one half | 3 (3.5 rounded down) |
| 20 May | submitted | 0 | zero | 0 |
